Agent Name: Orchestrator
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator first misplanned by instructing FileSurfer to “listen to” and extract page numbers from the mp3, even though FileSurfer could only display a failed transcription message and couldn’t actually play/transcribe audio. It then persisted in this unworkable path instead of leveraging ComputerTerminal for an offline transcriber (e.g., Whisper) or another viable method, leading to no real transcript and ultimately an incorrect, fabricated final answer instead of the correct pages (132, 133, 134, 197, 245).
